english.title: Fail to attend for jury service when summoned
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person duly summoned under the Juries Act 1974 to attend **(..SPECIFY VENUE..) at **(..SPECIFY TIME..), failed to do so in compliance with the summons
english.legislation: Contrary to section 20(1)(a) of the Juries Act 1974.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
fail to attend for jury service
in compliance with a summons

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Section 20(3) of the Juries Act 1974 shall not apply to a person summoned, otherwise than under section 6 , unless the summons was duly served on him on a date not later than fourteen days before the date fixed by the summons for his first attendance.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, being a person duly summoned under the Juries Act 1974 to attend **(..SPECIFY VENUE..) at **(..SPECIFY TIME..), failed to do so in compliance with the summons.
